[SWS_DM_01104] Operation Cycle restart
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04178
⌈
The DM shall only restart
operation cycles
after the previous restart has been
fully processed. In other words this means that there is no
operation cycle
restart
queue.
⌋
